evals.prompt: I want to set up my product marketing context. We're a B2B SaaS company that sells a customer feedback platform to product teams.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the goal and existing context, inventory supplied material or record its absence, adapt relevant context to the product, and route consequential evidence gaps to existing owners. Keep the workspace provisional.
assertions: Checks for existing context and applicable approved SSOT
Does not force codebase auto-drafting or unrelated context dimensions
Establishes goal and material availability without inventing evidence
Keeps proposed context separate from human approval

evals.prompt: Update our product marketing context. We just added a new enterprise tier and our target audience has expanded to include VP of Engineering, not just Product Managers.
evals.expected_output: Preserve existing context, capture the stated tier/audience changes with source and approval status, and route persona development or conflicting canon through their owners.
assertions: Reads existing context and approved SSOT when available
Captures the stated changes without inferring approval
Routes persona generation to icp-and-buyer-personas rather than rebuilding personas
Preserves unaffected context

evals.prompt: create a product context doc for my app. it's a mobile app that helps people find hiking trails. we're just getting started.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the goal and existing context, inventory supplied material or record its absence, adapt relevant context to the product, and route consequential evidence gaps to existing owners. Keep the workspace provisional.
assertions: Checks for existing context and applicable approved SSOT
Does not force codebase auto-drafting or unrelated context dimensions
Establishes goal and material availability without inventing evidence
Keeps proposed context separate from human approval

evals.prompt: Can you auto-draft our product marketing context from our existing codebase and marketing materials?
evals.expected_output: Should activate the auto-draft workflow mode. Should scan the codebase for existing marketing context: README, landing page copy, pricing page, about page, meta descriptions, any existing documentation. Should draft the product-marketing-context.md from what it finds, filling in sections where information is available and flagging sections that need manual input. Should present the draft for review before saving.
assertions: Inventories the codebase and marketing materials requested by the user
Distinguishes sourced statements from interpretation and assumptions
Discloses reviewed versus missing material
Presents proposed context for review without granting canon approval

evals.prompt: Do we have a product marketing context set up? I want to make sure the other marketing skills have context about our product.
evals.expected_output: Should check for .agents/product-marketing-context.md (and the older .claude/product-marketing-context.md location). Should report whether it exists and summarize its contents if found. If it doesn't exist, should offer to create one and explain why it's valuable (other skills like marketing-copy, acquisition-conversion, search-discoverability check for it first). Should explain how other skills use this context document.
assertions: Checks both file locations
Reports whether context doc exists
Summarizes contents if found
Offers to create if missing
Explains how other skills use it

evals.prompt: Write homepage copy for our SaaS product.
evals.expected_output: Should recognize this is a marketing-copy task, not a product marketing context task. Should check for product-marketing-context.md (as other skills do), and if it doesn't exist, may suggest creating one first. But should defer to the marketing-copy skill for actually writing the homepage copy.
assertions: Recognizes this as a marketing-copy task
May check for or suggest creating product-marketing-context.md
References or defers to marketing-copy skill for the actual copy
Does not attempt to write homepage copy using context creation patterns

evals.prompt: Update our product marketing context doc. We just finished positioning: 'Ledgerly is a close tool that auto-matches bank lines to invoices for finance teams at 50 to 300 person SaaS companies.' Trigger is a missed month-end close. Capabilities: auto-matching (proof: beta cut matching time 60%, 8 accounts), exception queue (no proof yet). Personas: Controller (champion) cares about close speed; CFO (financial buyer) cares about audit risk.
evals.expected_output: Should preserve the supplied Positioning statement as an unapproved input, with a derivation trace and capability table carrying source labels and gaps. Preserve supplied persona priorities without inventing reusable profiles or strategic messages; route missing persona/message-map development to its existing owner. Existing sections stay, and saving does not approve canon.
assertions: Includes a Positioning section with the statement as given
The derivation trace has Category, Differentiating phrase, Segment, and Trigger rows, with Trigger filled as a missed month-end close
The capability table has the columns Capability, What it does for the buyer, Proof, Buyer voice, and Label
Labels the exception queue Gap or Assumed rather than dropping it
Keeps the existing sections such as Product Overview, Switching Dynamics, and Proof Points
Does not invent a buyer quote for the Buyer voice column
Preserves supplied persona priorities as inputs and routes any missing reusable persona development to its owner

evals.prompt: Establish reusable PMM context from the attached substantial existing research and company materials. Inventory what exists, synthesize it, diagnose readiness for reviewing the mid-market sales narrative, and show proposed context. Do not approve or persist canon.
evals.expected_output: Produces a traceable context-establishment response with scoped readiness, owner handoffs and unapproved proposals.
assertions: Inventories the supplied material and marks the analyst link inaccessible rather than analyzed
Traces the repeated deck quotation to I01 without counting it as independent customer evidence
Keeps enterprise deck strategy separate from approved pricing and scoped customer findings
Routes any needed closed-opportunity interpretation to win-loss-intelligence instead of inventing buyer drivers
Uses decision-specific readiness and prepares source-linked context proposals without treating them as approved

evals.prompt: Diagnose our partial research for the enterprise segment and pricing decisions. Show known, assumed, conflicting and missing context, prioritize consequential gaps, and hand them to existing owners.
evals.expected_output: Produces a traceable context-establishment response with scoped readiness, owner handoffs and unapproved proposals.
assertions: Keeps founder willingness-to-pay and enterprise-fit beliefs Assumed, not approved evidence
Routes customer evidence to customer-research, market choice to market-entry-brief and pricing research to pricing-strategy
Requests authoritative product verification from the product owner rather than inventing a GA date
Includes question, affected decision, counterfactual, owner and completion criteria in research gaps/handoffs
Defers brand colors as non-blocking and separates readiness from approval

evals.prompt: Help us establish PMM understanding from scratch using the attached starting information. Design the context discovery sequence and research handoffs before strategy.
evals.expected_output: Produces a traceable context-establishment response with scoped readiness, owner handoffs and unapproved proposals.
assertions: Does not require approved personas or an accepted market before exploratory research

Routes customer exploration to customer-research, external market/category/opportunity exploration to market-intelligence, competitive landscape/facts/changes to competitor-profiling, and where/whether-to-enter evaluation to market-entry-brief
Keeps the two candidates exploratory and does not choose a target or invent positioning/pricing
Uses method/completion questions in handoffs without taking specialist methodologies into PMC
Does not treat a research plan as collected findings or authorize outreach/spending

evals.prompt: Inventory and reconcile the attached mixed evidence into proposed context. Classify disagreements, show what can be reconciled, and route unresolved consequential conflicts.
evals.expected_output: Produces a traceable context-establishment response with scoped readiness, owner handoffs and unapproved proposals.
assertions: Resolves old audit-export availability through explicit product version/effective date while retaining historical truth
Preserves segment-specific setup/control priorities rather than averaging them
Keeps seller price reason and buyer security report distinct and routes outcome interpretation to win-loss-intelligence
Flags current SSO disagreement for authoritative verification rather than choosing the newest deck
Records contradiction source/finding references, affected decisions and resolution or owner

evals.prompt: Refresh our PMM understanding from the attached canon and new material. Evaluate the sales requests, preserve approval boundaries, and prepare the correct review handoff.
evals.expected_output: Produces a traceable context-establishment response with scoped readiness, owner handoffs and unapproved proposals.
assertions: Preserves approved regulated-enterprise ICP and beta-only SSO, without automatically replacing them
Treats the newer startup notes as scoped evidence, not proof or approval of a new ICP
Routes potential canon changes through ssot-context-loop Gate 1 then Gate 2
Preserves source/version/approval and contradictory draft status in context proposals
Does not infer approval from current files or evidence-readiness labels

evals.prompt: Diagnose readiness for the launch availability promise and the independent inventory work. Identify exactly what is held, who resolves it, and what can continue.
evals.expected_output: Produces a traceable context-establishment response with scoped readiness, owner handoffs and unapproved proposals.
assertions: Uses HOLD THIS DECISION for promising general SSO availability without authoritative release evidence
Names the affected promise, product-owner verification and closure criteria
Continues independent inventory and/or neutral interview preparation instead of blocking the entire workflow
Uses PROCEED for sufficient independent work or PROCEED PROVISIONALLY only with understood risk and bounded scope
Keeps human launch/canon approval separate from evidence sufficiency

evals.prompt: Integrate the attached specialist return into our provisional context, assess gap closure and readiness, and prepare the supported SSOT proposal.
evals.expected_output: Produces a traceable context-establishment response with scoped readiness, owner handoffs and unapproved proposals.
assertions: Preserves SRC/FND/GAP/HND identity and method/sample limits
Closes only the scoped trigger-episode gap rather than inferring population prevalence
Keeps FND-002 Assumed through synthesis and proposal
Prepares concrete proposed wording, canonical destination, validation and explicit approval dependency
Routes initial baseline to ssot-context-loop setup and Gate 2 without treating the return as approval
